generation.scope: A finite full-middle-support graph on at least eighteen geometric sites forces opposite symmetry at opposite rank ten and excludes rank eleven. For two double points, two first jets in a confluent six-node square configuration force a forbidden secant equality. Each conic with an embedded node puts the simple mark on the fixed line through both double points, leaving at most one exceptional mark per parity. In a reduced six-node slice every nonsimple graph point has proportional contractions.

open_mathematics: Study the one-sided symmetric rank-ten finite branch by computing the commutator discriminant for two symmetric nets with four-dimensional sum. For graphs on seventeen or fewer sites analyze how confluent secants and re-marking behave when an additional unit of length is lost.
